Package dev.relism.flash.http

Class Exchange

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.http.Exchange
public final class Exchange extends Object
One request, its mutable response plan and the transport that executes it. Reused by a connection.

Handlers and middleware only prepare this object. execute() starts a delayed streaming body or duplex protocol after preparation has completed.
